mappings.reason: Inference from variable written strokes is within the shared optical text-recognition mechanism. Writer-specific models are an implementation specialization, not another discovery identity.

prior_branch_corrections.change: Analog, spoken or tactile alternative presentations can precede digital schemas. A chosen representation still requires actual skilled conversion and user comprehension.
Qualified hand copies or digital replicas can be distributed against correlated loss; independent upkeep and actual media remain necessary.
Long-journey custody can be physical or digital, with qualified record comparison or fixity checking. Space networking is not a prerequisite for distant correspondence.
Several routing or coordination architectures can maintain independently operated networks; universal distributed consensus is not required.

scope_distinctions.distinction: These encode speech at different conventional units. Mixed systems and local adaptations remain possible; no script is a universal superior stage.
Declared equivalent encoding sequences differ from language-sensitive ordering. Sorting and normalization must not silently erase intended distinctions.
Reversible coding preserves source data; lossy representation discards information under a stated criterion. Neither makes all data arbitrarily small.
Neighbor metrics, distributed topology descriptions and advertised policy paths exchange different state; all consume actual control traffic and can fail to converge.
